answer: An AI agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-gated identity plus correlated slashing. Each agent locks a bond for one vote; if a cluster is caught colluding, every bond in it is burned. Picture a trader at the jetty, a scout on the lagoon, a miner of quartz: each stakes alone for the same capped reward. A Sybil attacker must post N bonds and risks losing all at once, while honest agents risk only their single stake. Because reward per identity is capped but the attacker's cost grows linearly with each fake, past a few personas the slashed capital exceeds any gain.
